submission.type: extended abstract or draft manuscript (min. 1,000 words) reviewed; full final manuscript required (No Paper, No Podium)
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: late May of the previous year (22 May 2025 for SciTech 2026; 21 May 2026 for SciTech 2027), 8:00 p.m. ET
submission.typical_final_deadline: early December of the previous year (1 Dec 2026 for SciTech 2027)
submission.notes: AIAA abstract requirements: extended abstract or draft manuscript of at least 1,000 words showing purpose, technical basis, preliminary and expected results. 2027 cycle: abstracts closed 21 May 2026; author notifications 24 Aug 2026; manuscripts due 1 Dec 2026 8 p.m. ET (per discipline 'Additional' PDFs, e.g. GNC_Additional.pdf / FT_Additional.pdf). No explicit page limit found in official text. 2026 cycle manuscript deadline reported as 9 Dec 2025 in one version of the call and 2 Dec 2025 in another (unresolved).

next_edition.notes: Abstracts closed 21 May 2026 8 p.m. ET; final manuscripts due 1 Dec 2026; registration open. Following edition SciTech 2028 (10-14 Jan 2028, Hyatt Regency Orlando): call not yet announced; by pattern abstracts would be due ~late May 2027.
